prompt: A wizard in deep sapphire-blue robes stands in side profile facing right, one arm thrust forward, conjuring a surging wave of cerulean arcane energy from his palm. The blue wave collides head-on with an incoming crimson-orange fireball and shatters it mid-air, the enemy spell breaking apart into scattering embers and useless sparks at the point of impact.
